games.confirmKick: Remove {name} from the room? Their seat and current connection will be removed.
games.reconnectHint: Refresh to restore your seat in the same browser. Keep site storage and your seat credential private.
games.storageWarning: This browser cannot save your seat credential. Refreshing may lose your seat.
games.confirmDissolve: Dissolve this room? The room, game progress and all seat credentials will be deleted, and all players will exit. This cannot be undone.
games.confirmRestart: Return to the lobby? Current settings are kept and everyone must prepare again.
games.confirmQuickStart: Start a new game with the current players and settings, without preparing again. All players must be online. Start now?
games.confirmQuickRestart: End the current game and immediately start a new one with the same players and settings? Preparation is skipped and current progress is cleared. All players must be online.
games.confirmReconnect: Restore your connection? This replaces this seat's connection in any other page.
games.confirmLeaveRoom: Leave this room? Your seat will be removed, and you must ready again if you rejoin.
games.confirmLeave: The game will still wait for your actions. You can rejoin in this browser. Leave?
